title: ATW's Optimized
description: Client-side balance between performance and quality.
body:
## A client-sided vanilla modpack that **balances performance and quality**.

ATW'S Optimized hopes to balance performance without sacrificing quality to achieve it. Built on fabric, it runs incredibly quickly.

### Notable features include:
- Optifine Replacement (Including resourcepacks, capes, shaders, zoom, etc)
- Nvidium for increased performance for **RTX 30 & 40 series GPUs**
- Freelook mod (Similar to Lunar Client or Badlion)

Resource Pack/Shader Credits:
Vanilla Tweaks by Andre, Stridey, Grant, Rx: [https://vanillatweaks.net/](https://vanillatweaks.net/)
